data.location: Dallas Design District (former El Bolero space)
data.short_description: La Lupita Taco y Mezcal opened its first U.S. location in Dallas' Design District on June 2, 2026, in the former El Bolero space. The restaurant, founded in San José del Cabo, Mexico, is known for open-fire coastal Mexican cuisine.

Cobra Dogs is opening its first brick-and-mortar restaurant, with a soft opening planned for Nov. 1 and a grand opening party the following weekend. The hot dog brand previously operated as a food truck and catering business.

data.status: planned (in former Original Mattress Factory space)
data.short_description: Five Guys plans a new location in Ocoee at 10572 W. Colonial Drive in the former home of The Original Mattress Factory. It will be the first Five Guys location in Ocoee.

data.location: 880 E. Irlo Bronson Memorial Highway, St. Cloud
data.short_description: Five Guys plans a new location in St. Cloud at 880 E. Irlo Bronson Memorial Highway. It will be the first Five Guys location in St. Cloud.

Little Boat Bagels is targeting a late-November opening in Seattle's Magnolia neighborhood, with the timeline dependent on permitting. The concept comes from the team behind Backyard Bagel and will feature a new sourdough recipe.

data.location: 3702 Via De La Valle, Del Mar, CA 92014
data.status: closed for a "floor-to-ceiling transformation," expected to reopen spring 2027
data.short_description: Market Restaurant + Bar in Del Mar closed on September 21 for a complete renovation and is expected to reopen in spring 2027. The renovation will introduce a new design, expanded sushi experience, and enhanced private dining.

data.status: liquor license application submitted, final hurdle before reopening
data.short_description: Post Pub is preparing to return to 1422 L Street NW for the third time, following the closure of Kabuli Pulao. The tavern has submitted a liquor license application, the final step before reopening.

data.status: a few months from opening; exact date to be shared on social media
data.short_description: Hot Bunz is opening its third location, a larger space with indoor and outdoor seating, at 730 K St. in Downtown Sacramento. The smash burger restaurant is expected to open in early 2027.

data.location: 3428 E Atlantic Blvd, Pompano Beach, FL 33062
data.short_description: RimLay Seafood, a Thai-influenced seafood boil restaurant owned by Laddawan "Tammy" Boon-long, is opening at 3428 E. Atlantic Blvd. in Pompano Beach in December. The roughly 2,300-square-foot restaurant will have 80 seats.

Asheville-based Crave Dessert Bar is coming to DC at 2 Massachusetts Avenue NW, a historic building formerly occupied by Truist Financial Corp. The eatery has a liquor license application pending with seating for up to 75 guests.
Bluestone Lane, an Australian-inspired café, is set to debut at 1556 2nd Ave. on the Upper East Side. An official opening date has not yet been announced.

data.status: owners keeping restaurant name/concept under wraps
data.short_description: Flint Farmers' Market is getting a new, still-unnamed restaurant addition, with the team planning to debut it sometime next year. The addition is part of broader expansion plans for the market.

data.status: listed as "Coming Soon" on company website
data.short_description: Breakfast Republic is slated to open at 19079 Beach Blvd. in Huntington Beach, according to an ABC license filing and the company's website, which lists the location as "Coming Soon."

data.status: expected to open within the Bingle Village Shopping Center
data.short_description: Tacos Doña Lena is relocating its Spring Branch location down the street to a bigger space at 2030 Bingle Rd., adding a bar in the process. The new location is expected to open later this year.

data.status: concept in development, name not yet announced
data.short_description: A new American-style chophouse, developed by the owners of Carmelo's, is coming to the former Frisch's Big Boy location at 20 Kyles Lane in Fort Wright. The restaurant's name has not yet been announced, and it will seat approximately 160 guests.
Habit Burger & Grill will open a new location at 5010 State Rd. in Drexel Hill as part of its Philadelphia-area expansion in 2027.

data.status: planned; will take over former KFC location
data.short_description: Habit Burger & Grill will open a second new location at 9201 Roosevelt Blvd. in Northeast Philadelphia, taking over a former KFC site and operating as a freestanding drive-thru.

data.location: 26556 E University Dr., Suite 100, Aubrey, TX 76227
data.event_date: Construction begins December, wraps end of May 2027
data.short_description: Jersey Mike's will open a new location inside the Bates Towne Crossing shopping center at 26556 E. University Dr. in Aubrey. Construction is expected to begin in December and wrap up by the end of May 2027.
Rivers & Roads Cafe is expanding into the storefront next door at 1257 W Devon Ave. for a market and bookstore concept, hoping to open in early-to-mid November.
Firefly, a soft-serve focused ice cream shop, will open next to Rivers & Roads Cafe at 1257 W Devon Ave. in the spring.
Matcha Magic is closing its original cafe at 10246 Main St. in Old Bellevue on Nov. 1 due to the property's planned redevelopment, and is searching for a new Eastside location.

Flamin' Feathers is preparing to open a new, franchisee-operated location at 132 London Road in Delaware, Ohio, with construction underway and a mid-December opening targeted, pending final approvals.

data.status: no official date announced; will debut this fall
data.short_description: Divers Club, a European-inspired wine bar from the owners of Wine Dive and Grace & Proper, will open at 733 S. 4th St. in Queen Village this fall.

data.location: 2564 Yonge St., Toronto, ON M4P 2J3, Canada
data.status: "preparing to open" / exact opening date not announced
data.short_description: Oroshi Fish Co. is opening a second Toronto location on Yonge Street, bringing its dry-aged sushi to Midtown. The new shop will follow a small, takeout-focused format with an added fish-processing kitchen.

PopUp Bagels is opening a new Times Square location serving bagels fresh from the oven under its 'Grip, Rip, and Dip' concept. The grand opening will feature NYC-inspired menu items, a live DJ, and exclusive merchandise.

A new nightlife lounge is preparing to open in Baton Rouge, replacing the former Cedarcrest Bar by Provo. It targets patrons 25 and older with signature cocktails, rotating live entertainment, and a Halloween-night grand opening celebration.
A new Mediterranean-inspired rooftop restaurant is opening in Midtown Manhattan atop The Sanctuary Hotel. The Italian Riviera-inspired concept will offer seafood and premium meats with skyline views.

data.status: "kicking off its first full month open"
data.short_description: The Watershed is a new hospitality destination in Clarksville combining coffee, wine, beer, food, and event space across three concepts. It is hosting a month of programming including live music, a weekly steak special, and an art market.

data.status: "Our last day will be Sunday, October 18, 2026" / permanently closing
data.short_description: The family-owned Italian pizzeria in Spring is closing after nearly two years due to financial unsustainability. Owners shared an emotional farewell message thanking the community for their support.

data.location: 1736 First St, Livermore, CA 94550, United States
data.short_description: Zephyr Bar and Grill, a Livermore steakhouse and bar, is closing after more than 22 years, a year after reopening from a July 2025 fire. Owners said they were unable to find a buyer to continue the business.

data.location: 3355 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109
data.short_description: Article is about a new "Business Lunch Twist" menu offering at an existing restaurant, not an opening or closing.

data.short_description: Mudan Asian Bistro is coming to Centennial Hills in Northwest Las Vegas within the Albertsons shopping plaza, per a city permit. The dim sum concept will share the space currently occupied by New Grand China.
Toys "R" Us plans to open a store at The Outlet Collection Seattle in Auburn as part of its holiday expansion with Go! Retail Group.
Toys "R" Us plans to open a store at South Hill Mall in Puyallup under a lease lasting at least one year, with an option to extend.

data.location: 7007 Friars Rd, San Diego, CA 92108, USA
data.short_description: J.Crew is returning to San Diego's Fashion Valley mall with a redesigned location showcasing its signature prep and tailoring aesthetic.

data.status: "getting ready to open," subject to construction and permitting
data.short_description: HILI Fitness, a boutique studio offering Xformer Sculpt and heated fitness classes, signed a multi-year lease at The Shoppes of Sweetwater. This will be the company's 10th Florida and 12th overall location.

data.status: permitting just filed; "confirmed opening date has not yet been announced"
data.short_description: Crunch Fitness, operated by franchise company Undefeated Tribe, may be coming to a plaza in San Marcos near Texas State University. This would be the brand's second gym in San Marcos.

data.location: 5488 Chamblee Dunwoody Rd, Suite 7, Dunwoody, GA 30338
data.status: "under construction," exact opening timeline not announced
data.short_description: SWEAT440 will open a gym in Dunwoody, marking the brand's debut in Georgia, opened by Canton locals Ron and Gretchen Robinson. The owners also plan additional locations in Alpharetta, Marietta, and Roswell.

data.location: 4775 W Panther Creek Dr, The Woodlands, TX 77381
data.short_description: Lava Island, an indoor playground and family fun park, is set to debut in the Greater Houston area within the Panther Creek Village Center. The brand will open its first Texas location in Lewisville this fall before the Houston opening.

data.location: 3211 N Tenaya Wy, Suite 120, Las Vegas, NV 89129
data.short_description: Summit Shope, a specialty candy, chocolate, and tea shop, is working on its second Las Vegas Valley location inside the Doña Maria Plaza shopping center near Summerlin.

data.location: 6800 S Westnedge Ave, Suite H, Portage, MI 49002
data.event_date: by the end of the year
data.short_description: DiscReplay, a used games and tech store chain, is coming to Portage near The Crossroads Mall, marking its first Kalamazoo-area location. It will open at The Carillon Centre shopping center.
Juicy Joint, known for Halal Wagyu beef burgers and hot dogs, is expanding into brick-and-mortar locations including one listed as "coming soon" in Spring.
Juicy Joint is also expanding with a second brick-and-mortar location listed as "coming soon" in Houston, as the brand moves into franchising.

data.location: 660 Spadina Ave., Toronto, ON M5S 2H7, Canada
data.short_description: Casa Donato, a Montreal-based Italian restaurant and café, is opening in Toronto's Harbord Village. The first phase, a counter-service café, opens October 15, with a larger dining room and bar to follow in phase two.

data.event_date: Not specified (public filings list February 2028 completion date)
data.short_description: Gringo's Tex-Mex is expanding into the Austin-area market with a new ground-up, 9,500-square-foot restaurant in Kyle as part of the Kyle Park mixed-use development.

Hobby Lobby is planning a new store in North Natomas, Sacramento. The site is part of a large retail building where Burlington Coat Factory is also listed, formerly a Sam's Club that closed in January 2010.

data.location: Northwest Ocala, FL (specific address not specified)
data.status: development documents reveal specific details about the company's next expansion project
data.short_description: After opening its fifth Marion County location this summer at 115 Bahia Ave Place, Tractor Supply is planning a sixth location referred to as "Tractor Supply Blitchton" in northwest Ocala. Plans call for a standalone 21,702-square-foot building modeled after the "G+ Prototype" layout.

Lidl has opened a new store in Chelsea, its latest in New York City, with opening-day promotions and giveaways. The store occupies ground-floor space at Mabel, a mixed-income residential development within the Penn South campus.
Fleet Feet franchisees Michelle and Matt Mang are opening a second store in Eastport after launching their first in The Villages. The Eastport address has not yet been revealed.
Cabinet IQ is preparing to open at The Promenade Shops Centerra in Loveland, one of nine new tenants coming to the shopping center. A specific opening date has not yet been announced.

data.location: 2400 W Sahara Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89102
data.status: set to open/coming to Vegas this month
data.short_description: Los Amores de Julia, a Mexican Bistro, is expected to open its first Las Vegas location near the Sahara and Rancho commercial hub. It will open alongside Culichitown Las Vegas, a Sinaloa-style Mexican seafood restaurant.

Culver's is bringing its frozen custard and butterburgers to Spring, Texas, in the former Bank of America branch location. Construction started late last month and is slated to wrap up toward the end of September 2027.

Jersey Mike's Subs is preparing to open a new restaurant in Davis, with timeline still being finalized by franchise owner Ernesto Torres. It will be located in the Second Street Crossing shopping center, anchored by Target.

Onigiri Burgers is preparing to open a second Sacramento location, a Japanese fast-casual concept built around onigiri rice balls. The current location is at 4001 Freeport Blvd., Suite 110, in Land Park.

data.short_description: Fideuá Taste of Spain, a family-owned Spanish restaurant founded by Farman and Barbara Khaligh, opened its Las Vegas eatery. The couple developed the concept after years spent representing Scandinavian design in Spain and Portugal.

data.status: could take a year or more (renovations needed)
data.short_description: Gus's World Famous Fried Chicken plans to open a 4,400-square-foot relocated location on Red River Street, moving from its current spot at 117 San Jacinto Blvd. The current location will remain open until its lease expires in early 2028.

data.location: 16773 Bernardo Center Dr, San Diego, CA 92128
data.short_description: Elmisa Cafe plans to relocate to a larger space at The Plaza Rancho Bernardo, moving from its current location at 11611 Rancho Bernardo Road. The move is driven by a need for more parking.

data.location: 8430 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, FL 34747
data.status: about three weeks away from opening pending final approval
data.short_description: Back Yard Burgers is expanding in Central Florida with a new Kissimmee location, its second Florida restaurant after Altamonte Springs. The Mississippi-based chain has around six locations nationally.

data.location: 649 San Anselmo Ave., San Anselmo, CA 94960
data.short_description: Woods Beer & Wine Co. is preparing to open its newest location in downtown San Anselmo, with plans to break ground later this year. The company has expanded to six locations across San Francisco.

The Body Shop Bar & Grill, an automotive-themed bar and restaurant, is opening in a former bar space, merging classic car culture with drinks and pub fare. The building will house a front bar/grill and a rear working automotive body shop.

data.short_description: 7 Brew Coffee plans to open its first Lindale location, a 510-square-foot prefabricated drive-thru stand. The $1.25 million project is run by Tyler-Longview 7 Brew LLC, part of 7 Brew East Texas.

data.short_description: Saint & Rebel, an elevated bar-restaurant concept, is opening in the former Cafe Roma location in Central City. It blends traditional Louisiana dishes with a more irreverent, creative approach to food and drink.

data.short_description: Steak 48 recently submitted permitting documents for its Dallas debut in Knox/Henderson, its second Texas restaurant. The Arizona-based steakhouse chain already has locations in Beverly Hills, Chicago, Houston and other cities.

data.event_date: An opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Vicky Bakery is expanding its South Florida footprint with a new Pompano Beach location. The family-owned bakery, founded in 1972, has expanded to 25 locations across Florida known for traditional Cuban pastries.

data.status: preparing to build out a storefront
data.short_description: Zees Subs is planned for Jacksonville's Riverside neighborhood on King Street, according to a recent building permit issued in September. Details about the menu and planned opening date have not been publicly announced.
